tools.name: get_mental_health_benchmark
tools.description: CDC PLACES frequent mental distress (FMD) benchmark. Inputs: zip (string) or county_fips (5-digit). If neither provided, returns national summary. Outputs: scope (county|national|national_fallback), core values (pct and CI), optional national_percentile_rank, and marketing_copy.

params.name: county_fips
params.description: 5-digit county FIPS code; overrides zip if both are provided

tools.name: get_sector_snapshot
tools.description: Sector-level wellness snapshot over a lookback window. Inputs: sector (string), window_days (number, default 90). Outputs: institutions_with_responses, total_responses, avg_wellness_score, note.

tools.name: get_basic_alert_guidance
tools.description: Default alert thresholds by org_size and location_type (pre-learning baseline). Inputs: org_size (small|mid|large), location_type (campus|ward|store|office|other). Outputs: recommended_drop_pct, window_days, min_responses, rationale.

params.name: org_size
params.description: Rough size bucket of the organisation

params.name: location_type
params.description: Type of physical location being monitored

tools.name: get_institution_snapshot
tools.description: Institution snapshot over a lookback window. Inputs: institution_id (number), window_days (default 30). Outputs: total_responses, avg_wellness_score, last_response_at.

tools.name: get_institution_trend_daily
tools.description: Daily average wellness trend for an institution. Inputs: institution_id (number), window_days (default 90). Outputs: series of { day, avg_wellness, responses } sorted ASC.

tools.name: get_institution_alert_check
tools.description: Alert check: compares last 7d vs prior 7d avg wellness for a drop. Inputs: institution_id (number), drop_threshold_pct (default 15). Outputs: averages {last7, prior7}, drop_pct, threshold_pct, alert (boolean).

params.name: drop_threshold_pct
params.description: Percent drop threshold to trigger alert, default 15
